sinopsis.es: Tras la muerte de una niña en el lago de un pueblo, una escultora en busca de inspiración decide modelar su rostro y se adentra en un duelo que no le pertenece.
sinopsis.en: In a tiny village, a tragedy has just struck. Ángela finds herself trapped in an obsessive spiral, unable to find the inspiration for her next sculpture. She decides to immerse herself in the town’s grief and misfortune while sculpting the face of the young girl who was found dead in the lake. As the work progresses, she begins to uncover layers surrounding the death that she wishes she had never unearthed.
